name: KromiumConfig
declaration: @ConsistentCopyVisibility data class KromiumConfig internal constructor(val downloadConfig: KromiumEngineDownloadConfig, val browserConfig: KromiumBrowserConfig, val hardwareConfig: KromiumHardwareConfig, val securityConfig: KromiumSecurityConfig, val loggingConfig: KromiumLoggingConfig)
description: The master configuration object for the Kromium engine. Composed of specialized domain sub-configurations for engine downloading, general browser parameters, hardware/GPU acceleration, enterprise security, and logging severity.
whenToUse: Instantiate via KromiumConfig.builder() to configure the engine prior to calling Kromium.createEngine(config, provider) or provider.createEngine(config).

properties.name: downloadConfig
properties.description: Engine downloading, CDN release channels, and installation path configurations.

properties.name: browserConfig
properties.description: General browser settings, cache directory, remote debugging port, proxy, and custom schemes.

properties.name: hardwareConfig
properties.description: Host OS process model and GPU hardware acceleration options.

properties.name: securityConfig
properties.description: Chromium sandbox controls, telemetry blockers, WebRTC IP policies, and HTTP auth allowlists.

properties.name: loggingConfig
properties.description: Engine native logging severity level and log destination settings.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates this configuration and throws KromiumException.InvalidConfig if any values are invalid (e.g. remoteDebuggingPort outside 0..65535 or path traversal in cachePath).

methods.name: builder
methods.description: Returns a new builder for KromiumConfig initialized with default values.

exceptions.name: KromiumException.InvalidConfig
exceptions.whenThrown: When remoteDebuggingPort is not in 0..65535 or cachePath contains path traversal sequence ('..').
exceptions.recovery: Ensure port is within 0..65535 and supply a clean normalized filesystem path.
